reviews.title: No. Just no.
reviews.text: If you don’t buy the subscription, you get ads on every single click and if you don’t click anything it gives you one every minute. Without the subscription, you can’t track a single satellite except for the ISS. Hubble? No. Voyager? No. Even WiFi Sats? No. The subscription is pretty cheap, it’s a very small 0.49 a month, but I like to try no subscription before I buy it to see if the app is trustworthy, but I deem it is not.
